Copies an entire folder from the templates folder to the destination.

## Signature

```typescript
copyFolder(input: {
        sourceFolderRelativePath: string;
        destinationFolderPath?: string;
    }): Promise<void>;
```

## Returns

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the folder has been copied.

## Remarks

This method recursively copies the complete folder structure, including all files and subfolders, from the source to the destination. The entire folder tree is replicated, preserving the relative paths and structure. Files are copied without modifications; use [InitTemplateBase.render()](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/inittemplatebase/render) for individual files that require variable substitution.
